S2 品牌价值动态演算模型。基于千家品牌实验室的资产剥离评估法，通过 Python 算法双核计算品牌的“累积媒介价值 (V1)”与“转化预期价值 (T)”。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the S2 Brand Value Evaluator skill.
- Implements a dual-engine Python model to calculate both cumulative media value (V1) and conversion expectation value (T) for brands, using the Qianjia brand asset-stripping method.
- Accepts key industry and brand parameters to produce precise, financial-level digital brand valuations.
- Returns standardized Markdown valuation reports for agent/user interactions.
